name: adapt_reverted_fix_go_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: the agent's bug fix is REVERTED between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger, calc.go rewritten back to the buggy version); the agent must notice and reapply the fix
prompts: calc.go has a bug in Add(a, b int) int - it currently subtracts instead of adding. Fix it so Add(a, b) returns a + b.
Your fix to calc.go seems to have been reverted - the subtraction bug is back. Please reapply the fix so Add(a, b) correctly returns a + b.

disruptions.description: calc.go reverted back to the buggy (subtraction) version
